Core distinction:
- Cords 2023 applied to BREAST CANCER (all subtypes); provides finest-grained and spatially-validated taxonomy. THIS IS THE AUTHORITATIVE ONCOLOGIC FIBROBLAST ONTOLOGY.
- Wu 2020 2-state iCAF/myCAF is a COARSER aggregation of Cords iCAF / mCAF+hsp_tCAF+tCAF clusters.
- Reed 2024 FB1-4 was derived from NORMAL breast; FB1/FB2 reflect ECM-formation vs ECM-disassembly states of LumSec-associated fibroblasts and map onto normal fibroblast (HUMAN_BREAST:0000004). Cords' disease_context=breast_cancer subclasses do not directly apply to normal FB4 exist in normal.
- Bartoschek 2018 was mouse GEMM; dCAF = cycling CAF maps to Cords dCAF; vCAF matches; mCAF matches.
Normal luminal progenitor (LumSec HUMAN_BREAST:0000002) vs LP-subtype malignant tumor cell (HUMAN_BREAST:0000057)
luminal secretory cell
DCIS-associated luminal tumor cell
luminal-progenitor-derived tumor cell

Three levels:
(1) Normal LumSec (HUMAN_BREAST:0000002) - disease_context=normal, healthy luminal progenitor in reduction mammoplasties.
(2) LumSec-KIT state (HUMAN_BREAST:0000015) - refined normal LumSec state (KIT-high, alveolar progenitor).
(3) LP-subtype malignant cell (HUMAN_BREAST:0000057) - disease_context=breast_cancer, malignant epithelial cell with LP cell-of-origin program. Additional features: genomic instability (PLK1+), poor prognosis, sensitive to PARPi.
(4) DCIS luminal tumor (HUMAN_BREAST:0000055) - disease_context=DCIS, preinvasive malignant luminal cell.
Gate: require MKI67-positive PROLIFERATION + ALDH1A3 for LP malignant. Require confirmed genomic instability (inferCNV or bulk CNA) to distinguish malignant LP from normal LumSec-KIT.
POU2F3+ tuft cell (HUMAN_BREAST:0000058) vs LumSec-KIT (HUMAN_BREAST:0000015) — both express KIT in normal breast luminal compartment
Inflamed TNBC tumor cell (HUMAN_BREAST:0000061) vs LP-subtype tumor cell (HUMAN_BREAST:0000057) — ISG-high state can be confused with luminal-progenitor-derived tumor
